006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import java.util.Collection;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IModuleNodeItem;
011import dev.metaschema.core.model.IModelElementVisitor;
012import dev.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014
015/**
016 * A set of constraints targeted at the contents of a Metaschema module.
017 */
018public interface IConstraintSet {
019  /**
020   * Get information about where the constraint set was sourced from.
021   *
022   * @return the source information
023   */
024  @NonNull
025  ISource getSource();
026
027  /**
028   * Get constraint sets imported by this constraint set.
029   *
030   * @return the imported constraint sets
031   */
032  @NonNull
033  Collection<? extends IConstraintSet> getImportedConstraintSets();
034
035  /**
036   * Apply the constraints associated with this constraint set to the provided
037   * module, if applicable.
038   * <p>
039   * Callers of this method are required to track which definitions have been
040   * previously targeted based on the result of this method and to provide these
041   * to subsequent calls of this method targeting different modules. This approach
042   * ensures that a given constraint is not applied more than once.
043   *
044   * @param moduleItem
045   *          the module node item to apply applicable constraints to
046   * @param visitor
047   *          the visitor used to apply constraints to target definitions
048   */
049  void applyConstraintsForModule(
050      @NonNull IModuleNodeItem moduleItem,
051      @NonNull IModelElementVisitor<ITargetedConstraints, Void> visitor);
052}
